propositions: Ticking acceptance criteria checkboxes does not invalidate plan-review attestations because checkbox state is normalized out of the material basis by _normalize_checkbox_state

Staleness messages currently name a fixed fictional list (description/AC/file_impact/children) instead of reporting which components actually changed, making it impossible for operators to identify the root cause
Per-component fingerprints must be signed in the manifest because children are derived from other tickets' state at read time and cannot be reliably replayed from event store
The material basis comprises exactly four keys (ticket_id, description, file_impact, children) plus file_impact_scope when scope is none; AC is not a basis component
Pre-330c attestations hashed raw description and cannot be matched by normalized recompute or legacy grandfather, producing spurious stale-material verdicts on unchanged tickets
